title: Mae Floyd and Dixie Parker, Meadow Grass - Antique 1920s Sepia Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Mae Dorothy Floyd - Dixie Belle Parker
description: A 1920s outdoor snapshot capturing two young girls, Mae Dorothy Floyd and Dixie Belle Parker, sitting together in a field of tall grass with trees in the background. Reflects candid American family life from the roaring twenties.
